findings.text: At 390 the stats page scrolls sideways: shots/stats-390.png is 462 px wide, and the in-app table runs to x≈462 (the funnel table already ends at ≈395, past the 374 px content box). The cause is `public/join/stats/stats.css:416`, where `table.wrap { display: table; }` cancels the `display: block; overflow-x: auto` on line 415, so no table can scroll inside itself. Requirement 4 says "must read well at 390".

The per-visitor 300-rows cap at `worker/join.js:508` filters `WHERE visitor = ? AND at > ?`, but the only index is `(event, at)` (`worker/migrations/0003_join_events.sql:13`). So every beacon scans the whole table, and rows read grow with the square of ad traffic. Add `CREATE INDEX … ON join_events(visitor, at)` in a new `0004` migration (0003 has shipped to staging, so don't edit it).

The new index files are left uncommitted in worktree/qf-2: `public/join/stats/files.jsonl` is untracked and `public/join/files.jsonl` is modified. Law 10 says the new folder must be indexed in its parent, in the commit.

The funnel table starts with an empty column: `Stats.js:338-340` passes `this.head("")` and adds an empty `td` to every row. In shots/stats-390.png that blank column takes about 30 px of a narrow screen. Drop the column from the funnel table.

Counts are left-aligned in the funnel and split tables but right-aligned in Totals (`stats.css:418` vs `:421`). At 1920 (shots/stats-1920.png) each table stretches to 1100 px, so a number sits ≈400 px from its step name, and the three tables' columns don't line up. Right-align the counts with `td.num`, and cap the table width (or use `width: auto`).

The worker readme row (`worker/readme.md`, the `POST /api/join/event` row) says `e` must be "one of Funnel.js's own list". The list actually lives in `worker/join.js` `EVENTS`, and Funnel.js has no list. The same row's link label `public/join/stats/` points at `../public/join/readme.md`.

`Funnel.reset()` (`public/join/Funnel.js:60`) is never called. `Join.reset()` (`Join.js:309`) already clears every `join-` key from both stores, but the Funnel.js docblock (line 15) says Reset everything calls `Funnel.reset()`. Either call it there or delete it, and fix the comment.

No shot shows the non-admin state ("Admins only. Sign in at /join/ …"), and the closing log line says "denied-state … shot". Only the two admin shots exist, so that line of requirement 4 is unproven, though `Stats.js:314-317` reads right.

If `navigator.sendBeacon` throws (older Chromium refuses a Blob whose type isn't CORS-safelisted, such as `application/json`), the `catch {}` at `Funnel.js:57` swallows the error and the `fetch` fallback never runs. Sending `text/plain`, or calling `fetch` inside the catch, makes the fallback real. The staging walk shows the beacon works in current Chromium.
